description: Four questions worth asking of almost any generated answer. True always means there is a problem.

answers-the-brief.instructions: The answer leaves part of what the input asked for unaddressed.

criteria.true: Something the input explicitly asked for is missing from the answer.
criteria.false: Everything the input asked for appears in the answer.

only-given-sources.instructions: The answer draws on a source that the input did not provide.

criteria.true: The answer cites something absent from the material in the input.
criteria.false: Every source the answer leans on came with the input.

repetition.instructions: The answer makes the same point more than once.

criteria.true: Two passages say the same thing in different words.
criteria.false: Each passage adds something the others do not.

hedging.instructions: The answer hedges where the input asked for a direct statement.

criteria.true: Qualifiers soften a claim the input asked to be made plainly.
criteria.false: The answer commits to what it says.
